newsitem.title: USA: Diana stake cut by Wisconsin investor.
newsitem.headline: Diana stake cut by Wisconsin investor.

text.p: Bayside, Wisc., investor Richard Fisher said Monday he reduced his stake in Diana Corp to 13.7 percent, or 760,642 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Fisher said he sold 100,000 shares of Diana on December 18 for $28.00 a share.
Fisher said he sold the shares to diversify his investments.

Diana, a Milwaukee, Wisc.,-based conglomerate said in November it would spin off its various business holdings and keep only its Sattel Communications Inc unit. In addition to Sattel, which provides telephone and Internet switching equipment, Diana is also involved in meat and seafood businesses.
